gloss: large, medium, and small; all sizes

definitions.gloss: large, medium, and small; all three sizes; ranging from large to small
definitions.explanation: A set expression listing the three standard size categories. Used when referring to the full range of sizes available, or to indicate variety in scale.

examples.japanese: サイズは{大中小|だいちゅうしょう}の{三|さん}つです。
examples.english: The sizes are large, medium, and small.

examples.japanese: {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}どれにしますか。
examples.english: Which would you like: large, medium, or small?

examples.japanese: {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}さまざまな{企業|きぎょう}がこのプロジェクトに{参加|さんか}している。
examples.english: Companies of all sizes — large, medium, and small — are participating in this project.

notes:
A fixed three-character compound of {大|だい} (large), {中|ちゅう} (medium), and {小|しょう} (small). Functions as a concise way to express the full range of sizes. Extremely common in menus, product descriptions, and size selections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}の{三|さん}サイズ: three sizes (large, medium, small)
- {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}さまざま: of various sizes
- {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}どれでも: any size, regardless of size

USAGE:
At ramen shops and other restaurants, ordering by size often uses {大|だい} (large), {中|ちゅう} (regular/medium), and {小|しょう} (small) individually. The combined form {大中小|だいちゅうしょう} refers to all three as a set.
